stories.headline: Trump says monumental arch in Washington, DC will also be military complex
stories.description: Plans for the arch had been met with opposition along with other projects by the US president to reshape capital city.

stories.headline: What’s behind Iranian authorities’ push for a mass mobilisation campaign?
stories.description: Iran has launched a major mobilisation drive, sparking fears of renewed conflict with the US.

stories.headline: Israeli forces kill Palestinian near Jenin in occupied West Bank
stories.description: Israeli forces killed a Palestinian man near Jenin and an Israeli settler died from his wounds in a separate shooting.

stories.headline: Israeli settlers storm Al-Aqsa in latest targeting of East Jerusalem sites
stories.description: Netanyahu storms Western Wall tunnels amid Yom Kippur settler incursions, drawing fierce condemnation.

stories.headline: Ed Davey calls for immediate 10p cut to fuel duty
stories.description: Sir Ed blamed Donald Trump's war with Iran for damaging the UK economy and pushing fuel prices up.
